architecture.mechanism: Real-time pressure parameter monitoring with computerized analysis
architecture.intervention: Retrofit a low-cost piezoresistive pressure sensor to the downstream tubing coupled with a microcontroller to sample pressure rise rates and trigger an alarm upon exceeding a defined threshold, replacing or augmenting existing delayed mechanical switches.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in occlusion detection latency from minutes to seconds, preventing excessive pressure buildup and subsequent patient harm.
architecture.falsification_test: Induce a controlled downstream occlusion in a test rig with the retrofitted sensor and measure the time delta between occlusion onset and alarm activation; failure occurs if the delta exceeds 30 seconds or if false positives occur during normal pump operation cycles.
